reviews.title: Rock solid.
reviews.comment: This is a mega PSU.  It does a great job of handling my Astral 5090, even fully loaded.  I love the OLED displaying power consumption.  It comes with plenty of cables for practically everything.
reviews.author: charya

reviews.title: Great PSU!
reviews.comment: Does the job well! Much less random crashes from my GPU taking too much power. Came with more than enough cables for everything I’d need. No difference in volume compared to before coming from a 750w EVGA. It’s definitely on the spendy side but worth it in my opinion. The only downside I’ve found is that when it’s orientation in the fan down position the OLED screen is upside down which makes it look like gibberish until you get used to it 😅
reviews.author: Nick Ellinos

reviews.title: Terrible. DO NOT BUY. Major defect. The OLED screen does not work properly. KNOWN BUG ASUS SAID.
reviews.comment:
Terrible. ALL of these have a major defect. The OLED screen works but every 30-60 seconds it malfunctions and displays random lines then goes back to normal. GOOGLE it and you will find MANY people with the same issue. ASUS support said it is a known bug they do not currently have a fix for. It is NOT just one bad unit.
Waste of money. Do not buy it.
reviews.author: Danielle

reviews.title: Great PSU, no so great cables.
reviews.comment: Come with no issue, new version display the ROG logo every 10 seconds, but I hate the cables so much, they're so basic for such a high end PSU, I HATE Etched cables, next time at least put 16awg in every pin and crimp it properly.
reviews.author: Jose Cardozo

reviews.title: Handles my 5090 no problem
reviews.comment: I mean it looks amazing and def helped my pin load on my 5090 as it’s never been this good. Cables are super long and very easy to work with and look amazing. There is an anti burn feature that as it displays the watts, a Asus symbol pops up and then back to wattage. I have read some people think it’s broken but it is as intended.
reviews.author: Blueshirtfan
